dedupe_keys.name: la serena buildings of historic conservation interest inmuebles de conservacion historica

description: Municipalidad de La Serena, Chile publishes the buildings of historic conservation interest of the commune of La Serena, as a mapped layer distributed as a zipped file. Coverage: the commune of La Serena, Chile; created on the portal in 2018 and last modified on 2024-11-04. Format and access: ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Chilean open data portal (datos.gob.cl); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: the portal description is one line and the zipped file was not opened, so the geometry type, attributes and number of buildings are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: heritage-building exposure and protected-building constraints in seismic and tsunami risk studies for the coastal city. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: La Serena: buildings of historic conservation interest (Inmuebles de Conservación Histórica)
notes: Round 2 piece 14 (no-public-data visits): round 1 marked the Chilean bodies "MINVU Observatorio Urbano (municipal planning)" and "IDE Chile (mapping agency)" as publishing no data; the national open data portal datos.gob.cl was read on 2026-09-29.
